episodes.synopsis: Tsukasa thought she knew everything about Akimura. She's unsuspectedly rescued from half-devil, Anzai, who works with the police force specializing in devil-related crime.
episodes.title: Dark Side

episodes.synopsis: Trouble arises and blood is shed as Tsukasa tries to make sense of her new lustful feelings towards Anzai.
episodes.title: Safe House

episodes.synopsis: Anzai takes refuge with Tsukasa after being suspended. Meanwhile, the authorities are on the lookout for a missing murder suspect.
episodes.title: Paradox

episodes.synopsis: A sniper is out for revenge. Another random passing half-devil helps Anzai to recover by giving him a taste of blood.
episodes.title: Monster

episodes.synopsis: Devils throughout Kanto Region are transforming after witnessing a slasher attack broadcasted on live TV. Tsukasa suggests a new method to extend Anzai's lifespan.
episodes.title: Plan B

episodes.synopsis: Tsukasa is confronted about her relationship with Anzai. Anzai is called back into duty to take care of an emergency situation as he learns to accept his demon instincts.
episodes.title: Dogmatic

episodes.synopsis: As Anzai is struggling to keep a distance from Tsukasa in order to protect her, she is kidnapped by a devil hunter.
episodes.title: Chaser

episodes.synopsis: After being involved in a risky situation, Tsukasa asks Anzai if they are dating. Will Anzai be able to control his bloodlust in a relationship with her?
episodes.title: Offline

episodes.synopsis: Operations within the police force get shaken up as Lieutenant Ishimaru becomes the new leader of F Squad.
episodes.title: Command

episodes.synopsis: Anzai's ability to control his transformation is severely tested as he is confronted by a person from his past seeking revenge.
episodes.title: Ego Defense

episodes.synopsis: Immediately after Lieutenant Ishimaru issues a deployment ban on devils from the CCC, the police force ends up in a risky situation.
episodes.title: Ouroboros

episodes.synopsis: Tsukasa is willing to risk everything to rescue Anzai. Anzai learns about his past as he recovers from his injuries.
episodes.title: Devil's Line
